description: This file defines an interface 'PolicyCommandResponse' which extends 'CommandResponse'. It includes default method implementations and nested static class 'JsonFields' for JSON field definitions related to responses for policy commands in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PolicyCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface representing responses related to policy commands, supporting JSON schema versioning and header setting, with a nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: PolicyCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions for JSON fields specific to policy command responses, notably 'policyId'.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for this response, specifically version V_2.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with the policy command response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the response.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyId associated with this response.
